calls.actualPrompt:
Use case: background-extraction
Asset type: same-canvas semantic segmentation matte for the approved Uika study illustration.
Input image 1 is the sole edit target, not a style reference. Produce a fully opaque black-and-white segmentation image at exactly 1536 x 1024, with every visible Uika/person pixel solid white and every room/object/background pixel solid black. Preserve the original coordinate system, framing, scale, silhouette and occlusion: do not crop, move, resize, re-pose, complete hidden anatomy or redraw the character. Keep softly antialiased edges and fine hair tips.
White includes only the visible young woman: short pale blonde bob and hair wisps, face/neck/ears, white shirt, all visible arms and hands, her long taupe pleated skirt including its complete hem, visible socks and both black-and-white sneakers, and the actual small pen held in her hand if visible. Preserve the narrow spaces between arm/body and legs/shoes as black whenever room is visible through them. The opaque upholstered chair back/seat that occludes the woman remains black, leaving the same visible-only shape as the mother.
Black includes the entire room, window, scenery, chair and all chair legs, desk and desk legs, paper/notebook lying on the desk, tableware, lamp, floor and all cast/contact shadows. The white silhouette must not grow into the desktop or paper simply because her hand touches them. No chair fabric or wood goes white. No floor reflections, chair-leg fragments, shoe shadows or rectangular backdrop. No grayscale painting of body details: the person interior is white, the room interior black; gray only for a thin antialiased contour. Output a clean full-canvas segmentation matte, not a portrait, not a collage, not a transparent image.

Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: matching clean background plate for the approved Uika study illustration.
Input image 1 is the sole edit target. Remove only the seated young woman Uika, including all hair, body, clothes, socks, both shoes and her actually held pen, plus her small body/foot contact shadows. Reconstruct only the background previously hidden by her. Keep the exact full 1536 x 1024 canvas and the identical camera, scale, perspective and placement of every furnishing. No crop, shift, zoom, new subject or new object.
The desk, paper/notebook resting on it, lamp and cup remain exactly where they are, with their exact size, angle, shape and lighting. The upholstered chair stays in the mother's original position and perspective: preserve the original visible chair back, seat and wooden legs and complete only their locally hidden parts. Preserve the right window bench and its fabric, blanket, the floorboards and sunlight, the entire window with the same landscape, left desk/shelves/plants, curtains, wall drawing and rug. Do not rotate or enlarge the chair or desk. Do not redesign the room or borrow another empty-room layout.
Reconstruct the small revealed window/desk/chair/floor regions with matching original warm apricot daylight and the same delicate illustration texture. No ghost hair, skin, white shirt, taupe skirt, socks, shoes, person-shaped blur, residual shadow or reflection. Do not change any unaffected pixels intentionally. This is a clean plate for compositing the original mother pixels back into the same positions, so exact spatial alignment matters more than stylistic novelty. One coherent full scene, no side-by-side comparison, no text or watermark.
